interfaces.name: training
interfaces.constraints: Canonical real numeric CSR matrix with at least one row and one feature. Float32 conversion precedes fitting. Maximum uses stored entries only, excludes implicit zeros and ignores NaNs. Empty or all-NaN stored data, infinities and negative fitted maxima are rejected. Caller supplies training-only data in comparable normalized numeric feature coordinates.

interfaces.name: feature_columns
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty ordered list of unique nonblank feature identifiers matching matrix width. Identifiers bind feature semantics and order, not data rows. Caller must preserve fitted vocabulary and preprocessing semantics; equal width alone is insufficient.

interfaces.name: feature_coordinate
interfaces.constraints: Nonblank identifier of common comparable normalized numeric feature coordinates. A global maximum across unlike physical units is not meaningful; caller must normalize upstream. Exact identifier must match fitted state.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Portable JSON dictionary with exactly format, feature_columns, feature_coordinate and upper. Format sciona.fitted_sparse_clip.v1; finite nonnegative upper at most float32 maximum. No stored observations or executable deserialization.
